description: The bottom shaded right triangle I and the entire shaded square II have two EXACTLY congruent consecutive unit boundary legs under translation(3,1). Pair those two legs red/blue. Proposed error transfers the source triangle area1/2 to the full square through the matching open L and ignores their different closure. I and III retain correct total1 while II is wrongly counted1/2, selecting C.
